description: Actions that always require an explicit approval token before they execute.
always_required: publish, upload or transmit any master
commit rights, budget or licensing decisions
apply identity, likeness or appearance changes
clear backups or storage after checksum verification
export a delivery package that leaves the workspace
notes: The orchestrator enforces approval with --approve-plan (prints the token) and --approve <token>.
Approval tokens are deterministic per command and target set, so a stale token never unlocks a different action.
Capabilities whose names are rights, privacy, or delivery sensitive are present in asset-catalog-data.json with requires_approval=true.
